newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong dollar stable but testing key level.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong dollar stable but testing key level.

text.p: * Hong Kong dollar weak but steady at HK$7.7500 level despite regional currency weakness
* Dealers said currency forwards were active on continued reports of widespread hedging activity
* Two year forwards widened to 700 points on reports of active hedging after regional central banks sold two-year U.S. treasuries to yield cash to defend their currencies
* Hong Kong Monetary Authority intervention reported to stabilise currency forward market, but not confirmed
* Yields on Exchange Fund Notes: 3yr 6.33 percent; 5yr 6.53 percent; 7yr 6.66 percent; one week 5.31 percent
